links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified head and neck cancer patient education articles (baseline FKGL and FRES)
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Flesch Reading Ease Score) after LLM rewriting to a sixth-grade level
links.effect: Baseline mean FKGL 10.1 and FRES 51.5. FKGL ≤7 reached in 81.8% of articles for Gemini, 72.7% for Copilot and DeepSeek, and 18.2% for ChatGPT-4o. Claude met it in none. Gemini, Copilot, ChatGPT o3 and DeepSeek significantly reduced FKGL versus originals; ChatGPT-4o showed minimal change; Claude increased difficulty.
links.tradeoff: Effectiveness varied substantially across models, and Claude made text harder to read. Rewritten materials must still be reviewed for accuracy before public use.
links.quote: Gemini, Copilot, ChatGPT o3, and DeepSeek significantly reduced FKGL compared to originals, while ChatGPT-4o showed minimal change and Claude increased difficulty.

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompt for patient materials
